decision: Reopened in substance: the ticket's closure is not supported by evidence. The oven was reported faulty on 4 Aug 2026 (event-001) and confirmed still faulty by the tenant on 5 Aug (event-006); the landlord approved instructing an appliance repair contractor (event-010) and Lantern Works were briefed (event-013). facts.statement: Tenant reported the oven barely heating — food uncooked after 1.5 hours — at Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews on 4 Aug 2026.
